label: 3.2 cm Cuff Turn-Up
note: Owner-uploaded reference images. Authoritative for construction/appearance; NOT usable as the tech-pack illustration (not line art, or shows multiple options).

references.evidence: Studio photograph (474x310) of grey flannel trousers on a plain white ground worn with brown tassel loafers. Both legs finish in an unmistakable external turn-up cuff with a crisply pressed edge and a clean front crease. Scaling the turn-up depth against the leg-opening width and the shoe length puts it at roughly 5-6.5 cm, i.e. clearly deeper than the 3.2 cm this option names. Nothing in frame dimensions the cuff, so the exact depth cannot be settled.
